messages:
Jamie: heads-up — BankCo requested BYOK with proof-of-possession + 7yr audit-retention. Need an HSM import + RBAC plan. starting thread.
Maria: quick q — do we treat PoP keys as 'customer-escrow' or 'customer-managed' in our taxonomy?
Akash: infra perspective: functionally customer-managed, but import requires ephemeral admin access. propose new RBAC role `hsm.importer` (JIT, 12h max).
Olivia: compliance note: 7yr retention ok but PCI/Banking may want logs encrypted at rest with customer key too. Also need attestation package for import (vendor certs).
Jamie: initial proposal: customer wraps PoP with their KMS -> we run import under hsm.importer -> record signed import manifest (HSM serial, firmware, operator ID) -> store manifest hash in immutable archive + push to SIEM.
Akash: RBAC details: hsm.importer scoped to tenant + require MFA + restrict to allowed workstations. implement break-glass flow for emergency imports. Also add nonreplayable import nonce.
Maria: vendor attestation — can we accept vendor-signed cert chain + HW serial? BankCo explicitly asked for FIPS cert + HSM serial and firmware.
Jamie: yes. capture vendor attestation artifact during import and attach to audit event. update audit schema to include: vendor_cert_serial, hsm_fw_ver, operator_subject.
Jamie: ```json
{ "event": "hsm_import", "tenant": "bankco", "operator": "jamie", "hsm_serial": "HSX-123456", "vendor_attestation": "sha256:abcd...", "poP_signature": "base64..." }
```
Akash: vuln triage: found an issue in import-agent where stale operator tokens could be replayed to escalate to importer role. filed TKT-4392, POC attached. Impact: possible unauthorized import.
Maria: immediate steps: 1) revoke tokens issued last 24h, 2) pause new imports, 3) notify affected customers, 4) rotate any keys that could be impacted. @Olivia confirm legal/contract notify timeline.
Olivia: confirm — if keys potentially exposed, 72-hr notification window per SLA/contract. BankCo: pre-alert them. Preserve chain-of-custody logs and snapshot S3 buckets (object-lock).
Jamie: forensic update: logs show import-run at 6078912346 from operator svc-account; artifacts uploaded to secure ticket INC-2026-901. Will collect HSM attestation + firmware checksums.
deploy-bot: paused pipeline `job/imports` at 03:12 UTC — reason: security hold (automated action).
Akash: mitigation plan: enforce one-time import nonce + bind operator session to machine fingerprint + JIT tokens that auto-expire and are non-replayable. Will push patch to import-agent and add e2e test.
Jamie: action items: Akash -> RBAC & agent fix (TKT-4392), Maria -> customer comms + notify playbook, Olivia -> legal + compliance advisory, Jamie -> forensic + audit schema update. ETA 48h.
Maria: :thumbsup: I'll draft the customer comms (bankco pre-alert) and SOC2 evidence pack.
Akash: sample IAM snippet I'll add to PR: ```json
{ "Statement": [ { "Effect": "Allow", "Action": "hsm:ImportKey", "Resource": "arn:redwood:hsm:region:acct:tenant/bankco/*", "Condition": { "ForAllValues:StringEquals": {"aws:RequestedVia":"import-cli"} } } ] }
```
Jamie: also add retention tag `byok-high` to archives -> S3 object-lock + legal-hold for 7yrs. attach vendor-attestation pdf in evidence pack. ping INC-2026-901 for updates.
Olivia: I'll coordinate with PSG to ingest attestation PDFs and confirm storage encryption keys align with customer requirements.
Maria: we'll run a postmortem after 2 weeks. closing thread for now, ping me if anything urgent.
